dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Ah! The dandelions! They're all flying away!

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: What are you doing? Do you have any idea how much effort it took for me to grow those!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm scattering them far and wide...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: We're in the city! They won't get far before being blocked by those walls!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This way, we'll be able to grow many more dandelions...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Well, why don't you take some dandelion seeds outside the city and scatter them there, then?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Ugh, my dandelions! They took so much effort to grow, too...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Y—You... If you needed dandelions, couldn't you go outside to gather some?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: These dandelions were the ones you helped me gather, too! It took a lot of care to make them grow... and this is how you treat them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, uh, did something happen?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: You! Donna told me all about it — she saw you blowing my dandelions away!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, sorry about that...

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: I know — Donna told me all about it. You were the one who blew all my dandelions away, weren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: If you needed Dandelion Seeds that much, you could just have gathered some out in the wild. I was caring for these ones!

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Need I mention that these dandelions were the ones you helped me gather? Is this is really how you're going to treat them?

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: That'll do. Just find me some, and I'll plant them again myself.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Did you get my Dandelion Seeds?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: These are for you.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: ...Thanks. I'll plant a new pot later.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: But I'm never, ever leaving it outside again!

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Growing flowers isn't that easy.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: ...How about this, then? Find me some more Dandelion Seeds, and I'll plant them again myself.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: Once I'm done sowing the dandelion seeds into the new pot, I'll have to decide on a good place to put it.

dialogues.speaker: Flora
dialogues.text: ...Well, maybe I'll just display it outside again.
